title: pilea microphylla var. portulacoides
intro: Pilea microphylla var. portulacoides, commonly known as Thai Pepper, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilea microphylla var. portulacoides include expectorant, antipyretic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
